lines.text: Your AI agent says tests passed. Says payments sent. Says shipped. Says.
A log line is not evidence. Fresh matters. Bound to the exact commit matters. You find out downstream — when it's expensive.
var-runtime intercepts every critical action. No valid evidence — the lifecycle stops. With machine-readable recovery, so the agent corrects itself and tries again.
And it's small. One runtime, five lines, zero dependencies. Wrap any framework's tool calls — the gate does the rest.
Now watch the gate work. Fresh. Bound to the exact commit. Hash intact. Signed by CI's own key.
Admit. The decision itself is signed into a tamper-evident chain.
When the process dies mid-run, the session resumes at the exact step it stopped. State intact, meter intact — no re-payment.
Budgets are enforced, not suggested. Tokens, dollars, wall-clock. Irreversible work earns the flagship model — everything else routes cheap.
Every call carries signed identity — who is really asking, and what they may do. Later, the audit trail answers for all of it.
Edit one row of history — verification names the exact entry that broke.
Your agent says done. Now it proves it. var-runtime — open source. Proof-or-Stop.
